narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='c1'/>The second card is right. Five w squared plus six w is eleven w squared.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Test it with w as two. Five times four plus twelve is thirty two.
<bookmark mark='c3'/>Eleven times four is forty four, so the card fails.
<bookmark mark='c4'/>W squared and w are not like terms, so this expression cannot be simplified at all.
